title: File Store
description: File Store pipeline sink. Persists incoming lane data (documents, text, tables, and streamed image/audio/video) to the account-scoped RocketRide file store (the same store exposed via the client SDK's fs_* methods).
All writes are scoped to users/<client_id>/files/, resolved from the ROCKETRIDE_CLIENT_ID env var injected by the task engine.
For each persisted file a JSON reference {path, url?} is emitted on the json lane; the signed url is included when 'Emit download URL' is enabled.

filesystem.targetDir.title: Target directory
filesystem.targetDir.description: Base directory (relative to the account file store root) that lane-written files are placed under.

filesystem.emitUrl.title: Emit download URL
filesystem.emitUrl.description: Also include a time-limited signed download URL in the emitted JSON reference.

filesystem.urlExpiresIn.title: URL expiry (seconds)
filesystem.urlExpiresIn.description: TTL for the signed URL when 'Emit download URL' is on. Max 3600.

filesystem.pathWhitelist.title: Path Whitelist
filesystem.pathWhitelist.description: Regex patterns applied to the relative path of every write using re.search semantics: a partial match anywhere in the path is enough, so a pattern like 'secret' will also match 'notsecret/file.txt'. Anchor with ^ and $ if you need a full-path match (e.g. '^docs/.*$'). If non-empty, a path must match at least one pattern. If empty, all paths under users/<client_id>/files/ are allowed.
